title: Qwen-Image-Flash: Rethinking the Training Recipe for Few-Step Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2606.03746v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Few-step distillation has emerged as a critical component in the development of advanced visual generative foundation models, substantially reducing inference overhead while enabling real-time generation and cost-efficient deployment across a broad range of practical scenarios. However, prior work has predominantly focused on advancing training objectives, while comparatively overlooking the training recipe, which has become increasingly critical in the era of large-scale foundation models. In this work, we systematically revisit the training recipe under the well-established distribution matching distillation (DMD) framework for both text-to-image generation and image editing, focusing on three key dimensions: training data composition, teacher guidance within DMD, and task mixture. Our empirical analysis reveals several non-obvious and counterintuitive phenomena, ultimately motivating the development of Qwen-Image-Flash. Thes

translated_title: Qwen-Image-Flash：重新思考少步蒸馏的训练方案
translated_abstract: 少步蒸馏已成为先进视觉生成基础模型开发中的关键组成部分，它能够在显著降低推理开销的同时，实现实时生成和在广泛实际场景中的低成本部署。然而，以往的工作主要聚焦于改进训练目标，而相对忽视了训练方案，后者在大规模基础模型时代已变得日益重要。在这项工作中，我们在成熟的分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）框架下，系统地重新审视了文本到图像生成和图像编辑任务的训练方案，重点关注三个关键维度：训练数据组成、DMD中的教师引导以及任务混合。我们的实证分析揭示了若干非显而易见且反直觉的现象，最终推动了Qwen-Image-Flash的开发。
tldr: 该论文在分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）框架下系统研究了少步蒸馏的训练方案，涵盖训练数据组成、教师引导和任务混合三个维度，发现了多个反直觉现象，并据此开发了高效生成模型Qwen-Image-Flash。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically revisits the training recipe for few-step distillation under the DMD framework—covering training data composition, teacher guidance, and task mixture—reveals several counterintuitive phenomena, and develops the efficient generative model Qwen-Image-Flash based on these insights.
